mechanism: Task definition, SFT dataset and fine-tuning of models to predict the next code edit from edit history
evidence_scope: Then, we conduct supervised fine-tuning on a series of models and performed a comprehensive evalua- tion of both the fine-tuned models and other baseline models
evidence_role: we introduce the task of Next Edit Prediction, a novel task designed to infer developer intent from recent interaction history to predict both the location and content of the subse- quent edit.
